facts.value: Initializes the captured-opponent side of Captain SpecialHi: links the supplied captor, negates its facing direction, selects air versus non-air setup, requests ftCo_MS_CaptureCaptain, conditionally installs a position accessory callback, and invokes final common/animation helpers. Canonical name is ftCo_8009CA0C; ftCo_CaptureCaptain_Enter is an inferred alias.
facts.rationale: Implementation and registered grabbed-callback invocation establish purpose and roles without inferred cleanup or animation-source semantics.

facts.value: void(Fighter_GObj* gobj, Fighter_GObj* vic_gobj). In the checked grabbed-callback path, gobj is the captured fighter being changed and vic_gobj is the captor. Both user_data pointers are read without local null checks. The second object is stored in relationship fields and forwarded as the final motion-state argument; no local ownership transfer or lifetime validation is implemented.
facts.rationale: Preserves canonical parameter spelling and verified caller roles while leaving final-pointer semantics unresolved.

facts.value: Reads both user_data pointers; calls ftCommon_8007DB58, ftCo_8009750C, and ftCo_800DD168 on gobj in order; stores vic_gobj in victim_gobj and x1A5C; clears x221B_b5; and negates vic_fp->facing_dir into fp->facing_dir. Exactly GA_Air calls ftCo_800DB368(vic_fp, fp) and clears x221B_b7; otherwise sets it. Requests CaptureCaptain with Ft_MF_None, animation start/speed/blend 0/1/0, and victim_gobj as the final argument. Afterward, a clear current x221B_b7 installs ftCo_800DB464 as accessory1_cb. Final helpers assign 511 to x1A6A, invoke ftAnim_8006EBA4, and zero the acceleration/velocity fields handled by ftCommon_8007E2FC.
facts.rationale: Exact checked operations replace unsupported mask, cleanup, and animation-source wording.

facts.value: With valid inputs and returning callees, entry reaches its CaptureCaptain transition without a local early return. Only equality to GA_Air selects air setup; all other values take the else branch. The constraint helper skips guarded joint setup when x2226_b2 is already set, but still looks up the captor joint. Accessory installation tests current x221B_b7 after the motion-state call. Facing negation has no normalization or exceptional-float guard. No local damage, release timer, escape test, allocation, or lifetime enforcement is present.
facts.rationale: Documents precise boundaries and optional paths rather than unconditional or global guarantees.

facts.value: Provides the empty Phys callback bound by the active CaptureCaptain motion-state table. It performs no physics work or argument access itself. This does not establish suppression of all captured-fighter movement: entry may install ftCo_800DB464 as a separate position-updating accessory callback.
facts.rationale: Replaces broad prevention language with local no-op behavior and verified separate movement.

facts.value: Entry links the captured fighter to the supplied captor and requests ftCo_MS_CaptureCaptain. Exactly GA_Air calls the constraint helper and clears x221B_b7; every other value sets it. A clear current x221B_b7 after transition installs the position accessory callback. Anim, IASA, and Phys are empty; Coll delegates to ft_80083B68 only when x2226_b2 is clear. Entry requires valid objects and returning callees. No local exit timer or damage/release routine exists; partner pointers and stored callbacks rely on surrounding engine lifecycle management.
facts.rationale: Complete TU behavior with exact guards and explicit limits replaces inferred grounded-flag meaning.
